next_ai.positive: Freeze and execute META_N073 on real scientific A-B-C bridge packets; retain richer path certification only if it improves valid target-transfer precision or failure localization without blocking regressions.
next_ai.null: If pairwise-only validation matches full path certification at lower cost, preserve the null and keep BRIDGE_TO as simpler navigation rather than mandatory richer composition.
next_ai.refuted: If known valid scientific compositions are rejected, preserve counterexamples and narrow handoff/QoI/regime/error contracts or add relation-specific composition rules rather than weakening the global no-authority boundary.
next_ai.partial_id: If a path is locally valid but invariant, regime, error semantics or handoff identity is incomplete, retain NAVIGABLE_ONLY or CANNOT_CHECK rather than selecting a story.
next_ai.blocked: If intermediate identity, role semantics, QoI, validity regime, evidence lineage, error semantics/composition rule or target test cannot be observed, fail closed and record the blocker.
next_ai.transport: If main moves during future candidate evaluation, rebuild against current main while preserving frozen benchmarks, addenda and negative history.
